WITH target_instrument AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM instruments
  WHERE id IN ($instrument)
)

SELECT
  o.start_time AS time,
  o.end_time AS timeEnd,
  t.name || ' OFF' AS title,
  'SEM server offline' AS text
FROM em_off o
JOIN target_instrument t
  ON o.instrument_id = t.id

targets.rawSql:
WITH counter_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FEG'
    AND param_name = 'OperateTimeFEGParameter'
)

SELECT d.value_num AS "OperationTimeCounter"
FROM data d
JOIN counter_param p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time) 
ORDER BY d.time DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id, param_name
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name IN ('I-Column.IGP1_PeakCount', 'I-Column.IGP2_PeakCount')
    AND subsystem = 'Vacuum'
)
SELECT
  p.param_name,
  MAX(d.value_num) - MIN(d.value_num) AS counts
FROM data d
JOIN state_param p USING (param_id)
WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
GROUP BY p.param_name

WITH param_ids AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'E-Column'
    AND param_name = 'E-Column.IGP1'
),

daily_avg AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('1 day', d.time) AS day,
    p.param_name,
    AVG(d.value_num) AS avg_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN param_ids p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
  WHERE
    d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND d.value_num > 0
  GROUP BY day, p.param_name
)

SELECT
  day AS time,
  param_name,
  avg_value AS "24-hour average",
  AVG(avg_value) OVER (
    PARTITION BY param_name
    ORDER BY day
    ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS "4-week average"
FROM daily_avg
ORDER BY day, param_name;

WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT param_id, enum_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FEG'
    AND param_name = 'ExternalStateParameter'
),

enums AS (
  SELECT e.enum_id, e.member_name, e.value
  FROM enum_values e
  JOIN state_param p ON p.enum_id = e.enum_id
)

SELECT
  e.member_name AS "State",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM data d
JOIN state_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
JOIN enums e ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
  AND e.value = d.value_num
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
GROUP BY e.member_name
ORDER BY "Count" DESC

WITH param_ids AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'E-Column'
    AND param_name = 'E-Column.IGP2'
),

daily_avg AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('1 day', d.time) AS day,

  WHERE
    d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)

SELECT

  avg_value AS "24-hour average",
  AVG(avg_value) OVER (
    PARTITION BY param_name
    ORDER BY day
    ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS "4-week average"

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FEG'
    AND param_name = 'EmissionFEGParameter'
)

SELECT
  time,
  value
FROM unnest((
  SELECT lttb(
    time,
    value_num,
    2 * (($__to - $__from) / $__interval_ms)::int
  )
  FROM data
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_id = (SELECT param_id FROM matching_param)
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
))
ORDER BY 1;

WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id, param_name
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name IN ('I-Column.IGP3_PeakCount', 'I-Column.IGP4_PeakCount')
    AND subsystem = 'Vacuum'
)
SELECT
  p.param_name,
  MAX(d.value_num) - MIN(d.value_num) AS counts
FROM data d

WHERE instrument_id = $instrument

GROUP BY p.param_name

WITH param_ids AS (

    param_name,
    param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'I-Column'
    AND param_name IN ('IGP3Parameter', 'I-Column.IGP3')
),

daily_avg AS (

    p.param_name,

SELECT

  ) AS "4-week average"

WITH params AS (
  SELECT instrument_id, param_id, param_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FIB'
    AND param_name LIKE 'GasUsage_%Parameter'
),

totals AS (
  SELECT
    substring(p.param_name FROM '^GasUsage_(.+)Parameter$') AS gas_type,
    delta(counter_agg(d.time, d.value_num)) AS total_usage
  FROM data d
  JOIN params p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d.time)
  GROUP BY p.param_name
)

SELECT
  gas_type,
  total_usage,
  total_usage * 100.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(total_usage) OVER (), 0) AS pct_of_total
FROM totals
ORDER BY pct_of_total DESC

WITH counter_param AS (
  SELECT instrument_id, param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FIB'
    AND param_name IN ('SourceAgeParameter', 'OperatingTimeFIBParameter')
),

filtered AS (
  SELECT
    d.time,
    d.value_num AS operate_time
  FROM data d
  JOIN counter_param p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
),

changes AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    operate_time,
    lag(operate_time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_value
  FROM filtered
),

last_replacement AS (
  SELECT time
  FROM changes
  WHERE operate_time < prev_value   -- counter reset
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

last_value AS (
  SELECT last(operate_time, time) AS source_age
  FROM filtered
)

SELECT
  lv.source_age / 3600 AS "Source age",
  lr.time AS "Last replacement"
FROM last_value lv
LEFT JOIN last_replacement lr ON true

WITH counter_param AS (
  SELECT instrument_id, param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FIB'
    AND param_name = 'TotalLifetimeHeatsParameter'
),

last_reset AS (
  SELECT MAX(d.time) AS reset_time
  FROM data d
  JOIN counter_param p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
  WHERE d.value_num = 0
)

SELECT MAX(d.value_num) AS heat_cycles
FROM data d
JOIN counter_param p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
WHERE d.time >= COALESCE(
  (SELECT reset_time FROM last_reset),
  to_timestamp($__from/1000)
)

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FIB'
    AND param_name = 'EmissionFIBParameter'

SELECT

WITH param_ids AS (

    param_id
  FROM parameters

    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'I-Column'
    AND param_name LIKE 'IGP4Parameter'

daily_avg AS (

    AVG(d.value_num) AS avg_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN param_ids p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
  WHERE

    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND d.value_num > 0

SELECT
  day AS time,

    PARTITION BY param_name
    ORDER BY day

  ) AS "4-week average"
FROM daily_avg
ORDER BY day, param_name;

WITH target_param AS (
  SELECT
    instrument_id,
    param_id
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FIB'
    AND param_name = 'JacketFlowParameter'
)

SELECT
  time_bucket('1 week', d.time) as bucket,
  avg(d.value_num) AS mean_flow
FROM data d
JOIN target_param p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.time)
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH latest_week AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 week', max(d.time)) AS bucket
  FROM data d
  JOIN parameters p
    ON d.instrument_id = p.instrument_id
   AND d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND p.component = 'FIB'
    AND p.param_name IN ('SuccessfulIgnitionCountParameter', 'TotalIgnitionCountParameter')
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(delta(counter_agg(d.time, d.value_num) FILTER (WHERE p.param_name = 'SuccessfulIgnitionCountParameter')), 0), 1)::float
  /
  COALESCE(NULLIF(delta(counter_agg(d.time, d.value_num) FILTER (WHERE p.param_name = 'TotalIgnitionCountParameter')), 0), 1) AS ratio

FROM data d
JOIN parameters p
  ON d.instrument_id = p.instrument_id
 AND d.param_id = p.param_id
JOIN latest_week lw
  ON time_bucket('1 week', d.time) = lw.bucket
WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND p.component = 'FIB'
  AND p.param_name IN ('SuccessfulIgnitionCountParameter', 'TotalIgnitionCountParameter')
